prompt: A temple workshop of scribes and craftsmen: low tables with papyrus rolls, ink palettes and reed pens; an artisan's bench with gold, faience amulets and a small furnace glowing; painted walls and oil lamps. Made by hand like a 1993 fantasy game-book illustration: bold, wobbly black pen-and-ink outlines, thin flat transparent watercolour washes with blotchy hard edges, a little cross-hatching, rough off-white paper grain showing through; ancient Egyptian, New Kingdom, with the flat bright colours of tomb painting (lapis, turquoise, red ochre, gold, palm green); colourful rather than muddy. No Greek, Norse or Chinese elements. No text. Dark around the edges, no people.
